title.narrative: LO Trade Unions Fighting Inequality and Reconstructing Peace and Democracy in Ukraine

description.narrative:
The project aims to rebuild and strengthen Ukraine’s trade union movement by enhancing its capacity in three core areas: (1) Membership; (2) Collective bargaining and tripartite cooperation; and (3) Occupational health and safety (OHS). Through this, the project will contribute to a democratic, inclusive and rights based reconstruction of Ukraine, where workers’ rights are protected in line with ILO conventions and relevant EU labour standards.
The project will be implemented by the Norwegian Confederation of Trade Unions (LO) in partnership with Solidarity Centre (SC) and the Ukrainian organisation Labour Initiatives (LI), in close cooperation with the Federation of Trade Unions of Ukraine (FPU), the Confederation of Free Trade Unions of Ukraine (KVPU) and selected sectoral and independent unions. Activities will include legal counselling and representation, capacity development for union leaders and organisers, support to organising and membership growth, and strengthened advocacy and participation in social dialogue and tripartite structures at sectoral and national levels. Due to the security situation, parts of the training and exchanges will be conducted in Norway or third countries.
The project has a particular focus on reducing inequality in the labour market, including for marginalised and vulnerable workers such as veterans, workers with disabilities and women. Trade unions will be supported to better represent these groups, integrate their concerns into collective agreements, and promote safer and more inclusive workplaces through improved OHS systems and practices. By the end of the project period, Ukrainian trade unions are expected to have stronger membership bases, enhanced bargaining power, and improved ability to influence labour law reforms and reconstruction processes, thereby contributing to social cohesion and democratic development in Ukraine.
